solutions.title: Copy paths
solutions.strategy: Pass a copied path list into each child during DFS.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node can copy a root-to-node path of length up to h.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Copied paths across recursion can accumulate with path length.

solutions.title: Backtracking
solutions.strategy: Maintain one mutable path and copy it only when a matching leaf is found.

timeComplexity.explanation: Traversal visits n nodes and copies each matching path of length up to h.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The working path and recursion stack follow tree height, excluding output.
